title: Gallery theme
description: A colour theme for the public site, the admin and PDF invoices. The file name (without .json) is the theme's id.

icon.description: Icon shown next to the name.

scheme.description: Tells the browser whether to draw light or dark scrollbars and form controls.

extends.description: Id of another theme to start from. Only the colours you list are changed.

invoice.description: Overrides used only on PDF invoices, e.g. a white page for printing. Invoices use bg, text, text-muted, text-subtle, border, border-strong, surface and highlight.

color.description: Any CSS colour: #rrggbb, rgba(…), hsl(…). Invoices understand hex and rgb()/rgba() only.

colors.description: Each key becomes a CSS custom property ("bg" → --bg).

bg-elevated.description: Cards, panels, inputs and the admin sidebar.

surface.description: Hover fills, active navigation, code backgrounds.

text.description: Primary text and the default ink.

accent.description: Selected states, chips and accent buttons.

placeholder.description: Background behind images while they load.

highlight.description: Optional. Replaces the ink colour for solid buttons, eyebrows, focus rings and selection.

chart-1.description: Optional. Main analytics chart colour (default: highlight, or text).

chart-2.description: Optional. Second step of the chart ramp.

chart-3.description: Optional. Third step of the chart ramp.

chart-4.description: Optional. Lightest step of the chart ramp.
